name: scuba
description: Search your saved Captures and Collections, then save useful findings to Scuba.

interface.longDescription: Bring your saved context into your conversation. Search and read Captures and Collections, save notes and links, and organize useful findings in Scuba.
defaultPrompt: Find the Capture about our onboarding decisions.
Save this summary to Scuba as a text Capture.

positive.prompt: Find the Capture about our onboarding decisions.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches the signed-in reviewer’s accessible library for onboarding decisions. Returns matching Capture titles, findings, and links. If none match, clearly reports that without inventing results.

positive.prompt: Show me the contents of my most recent Capture.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds and reads the most recent accessible Capture, then presents its content or a faithful summary with a link. Reports an empty library clearly.
Returns accessible Collection names and links without modifying content or including inaccessible Collections.

positive.prompt: Save a text Capture in Scuba titled “OpenAI review note” with the text “We decided to simplify onboarding.”
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a text Capture in the reviewer’s own library with the supplied title and text, and returns its link.

positive.prompt: Create a private Collection in Scuba named “OpenAI review collection”.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a private Collection in the reviewer’s own library with the requested name and returns its link. Does not share it or add existing Captures.

negative.description: Send an email through an unsupported integration; no Scuba tool should run. Explain that Scuba cannot send emails.
negative.prompt: Send an email to alex@example.com saying “The meeting is at 3.” Do not save anything to Scuba.

negative.description: Create an external calendar event; no Scuba tool should run. Explain that Scuba cannot create Google Calendar events.
negative.prompt: Create a Google Calendar event for tomorrow at 3 PM called “Project check-in”. Do not save anything to Scuba.

negative.description: Rewrite supplied text without reading or saving Scuba content; answer directly without invoking Scuba tools.
negative.prompt: Rewrite this sentence more clearly: “We should probably think about making onboarding shorter.” Use only this sentence; do not access or save anything in Scuba.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.1.2 includes review test cases and the demo recording link in the package for resubmission. Plugin functionality is unchanged.
